audience: anyone who follows soccer a little
summary: Too easy for Today's list. The top 10 is just the ten most famous clubs, so a casual player finds 8 to 10 and a fan sweeps it. Only Juventus (#16) and AC Milan (#15) catch anyone out. It works well as a Blitz, where everyone can keep typing clubs that score.
reasons: Casual found 10/10 in 13 guesses and lost lives only on Juventus and AC Milan, which both show their revenue. A US player who barely follows soccer still found 8. The fan swept it in 10 guesses without losing a life, so there is no stretch answer.

Players will enjoy recognizing names, but there are few surprises: the only 'huh' moment is Juventus and Milan dropping out while Spurs and Chelsea stay in. The prompt is clear (soccer, 2024–25, Deloitte). Short forms work (barca, man utd, psg, spurs, bayern), and NFL, MLS and Saudi clubs are free.
Blitz: Premier League and big European clubs keep scoring (19 of 24). Ajax, Celtic, Napoli and Leeds don't score.
fixes: This ranks one season, but every club from every Money League since 1996–97 costs a life and shows an old figure: 'celtic' shows '#17 in 2006–07', 'leverkusen' shows '#24 in 2004–05', and Parma shows no figure at all. In topics.ts `also`, keep only 2023–24 and 2022–23 (tables 4 and 6) as costly near misses. Make clubs last ranked before that (Ajax, Leicester, Porto, Celtic, Rangers, Bayer Leverkusen, Schalke and the rest) free knownNames.
